issues.explanation: Combines the place-origin noun 人 with the personal name 张角, hiding the name and giving an unnatural gloss.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 人 and 张角 separately; 人 means person/native of the place.

issues.explanation: In 进山, this means enter/go into, not generally go forward.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to enter” or “to go into.”

issues.explanation: Here 山 means mountain and is not a surname.
Here 药 means medicinal herbs/medicine, not the iris leaf.
Here 遇 is the verb “to meet/encounter,” not a surname.
In 南华老仙, this is part of the epithet/name Nanhua, not “South China.”
得 means “to obtain/receive” here and is a verb, not a particle.
三 is the numeral three, not a surname.
卷 is a measure word for scrolls or volumes in 三卷天书, not “to roll up.”
天书 means a celestial/divine book or scriptures, not an imperial edict.
符 is a common noun meaning talisman in 符水, not a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to word and gloss as “talisman.”

issues.explanation: In 符水, 水 means water, specifically talisman-infused water, not a surname.
和 is the conjunction “and” here, not the surname He.
师 is the common noun/title element “master/teacher” in 大贤良师, not a surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to word and gloss as “master; teacher.”

issues.explanation: 广 functions as an adverb meaning extensively/widely in 广收门徒; the radical definition is irrelevant.
立 means establish/set up in 立三十六方, not the surname Li.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to establish” or “to set up.”

issues.explanation: 方 refers to organized regions/divisions in 立三十六方, not the surname Fang.
In 黄天当立, 当 means should/will be due to or ought to, not an onomatopoeia.
派 means dispatch/send in 派马元义 and 派卢植等, not the unrelated expression 派司.
带 means carry/take along in 带金帛, not band.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to carry; to take along.”

issues.explanation: 被 is the passive marker in 被斩, not “quilt.”
等 means “and others” after 封谞, not “to wait for.”
In 天公将军、地公将军、人公将军, 将军 means general/military title, not a place name.
称 means call/name/designate in 张梁称…, not “to fit.”
万 means ten thousand in 四五十万人, not the surname usage from 万俟.
路 means route/road in 分路讨伐, not the surname Lu.
In 岁在甲子 and 在幽州, 在 marks being/occurring in a time or location; “to exist” is too generic for the local context.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “be in; occur in” or “at/in.”

issues.explanation: The historical name is pronounced Zhū Jùn, not Zhū Juàn.
